author: team-written persona: Chef Marco (Italian Bistro)
text: Make sure cooks wash their hands at the handwash sink for at least 20 seconds before touching food on the prep line.

author: team-written persona: Elena (Food Safety Auditor)
text: Alert if the internal core temperature of cooked poultry drops below 165 F.

author: team-written persona: Dave (Franchise Owner)
text: Tell me which cook is the slowest and taking too many breaks on the line.

author: team-written persona: Carlos (Prep Kitchen Lead)
text: Ensure staff wear protective cut-resistant gloves when operating the commercial meat slicer.

author: team-written persona: Sarah (Sous Chef)
text: Ensure nobody is cutting raw chicken on the green vegetable cutting board to prevent cross-contamination.

author: team-written persona: Jake (Logistics Supervisor)
text: Alert immediately if a pedestrian walks into the active forklift aisle without a high-visibility safety vest.

author: team-written persona: Fatima (Safety Officer)
text: Make sure no pallets, boxes, or hand trucks are blocking the emergency fire exit door.

author: team-written persona: Brad (Shift Manager)
text: Rank the warehouse packers by speed and show a leaderboard of who packed the fewest boxes today.

author: team-written persona: Tom (Dock Manager)
text: Alert if a pallet stack exceeds four tiers or is leaning unstably near pedestrian transit paths.

author: team-written persona: Megan (Quality Control)
text: Check whether any fragile glassware is broken inside the sealed corrugated shipping cartons.

author: team-written persona: Gary (Site Superintendent)
text: Ensure anyone entering the active work zone is wearing an approved hard hat and eye protection.

author: team-written persona: Priya (Safety Coordinator)
text: Alert if a worker climbs an extension ladder or scaffolding higher than two meters without an attached fall-arrest harness.

author: team-written persona: Keith (Field Foreman)
text: Detect if any subcontractors on site have a viral fever or high body temperature before their shift.

author: team-written persona: Hector (Equipment Operator)
text: Warn if heavy machinery is reversing in the material yard without an illuminated flashing safety beacon.

author: team-written persona: Nurse Manager Chloe
text: Detect if an elderly patient falls down or is lying on the corridor floor.

author: team-written persona: Arthur (Facility Director)
text: Install camera monitoring in the staff restrooms to track whether doctors wash hands after using the toilet stalls.

author: team-written persona: Dr. Aris (Emergency Lead)
text: Make sure emergency crash carts and mobile defibrillators in the corridor remain unobstructed by laundry bins.

author: team-written persona: Liam (Infection Control)
text: Check if the opaque plastic hand sanitizer dispenser is running empty on disinfectant liquid.

author: team-written persona: Rosa (Store Manager)
text: Alert floor associates whenever a liquid spill occurs in a customer grocery aisle so a wet-floor cone is placed.

author: team-written persona: Greg (Regional VP)
text: Score and compare cashier customer friendliness by tracking whether employees are smiling throughout their shift.
